$$\frac{6P - 4p_\gamma \cos\theta}{4m} = 0 \implies P = \frac{2}{3} p_\gamma \cos\theta$$
(Assuming $\theta$ is acute, $P \ge 0$ is satisfied.)
Substituting this back into $K$:
$$K_{min} = \frac{3(\frac{4}{9}p_\gamma^2 \cos^2\theta) - 4p_\gamma(\frac{2}{3}p_\gamma \cos\theta)\cos\theta + 2p_\gamma^2}{4m} = \frac{p_\gamma^2(3 - 2\cos^2\theta)}{6m}$$

$$p_\gamma c = \frac{p_\gamma^2(3 - 2\cos^2\theta)}{6m} + \Delta U$$
Let $\alpha = \frac{3 - 2\cos^2\theta}{6m}$. We have a quadratic equation for $p_\gamma$:
$$\alpha p_\gamma^2 - c p_\gamma + \Delta U = 0$$
The minimum valid momentum is the smaller root:

Since $\omega_{min} = \frac{p_{\gamma, min}c}{\hbar}$, we get the exact minimum angular frequency:

   The slope $m_A$ of the reflected line is the tangent of this angle:
   $$m_A = \tan\left(\frac{3\pi}{2} - 2\theta\right) = \tan\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - 2\theta\right) = \cot(2\theta)$$
   This matches the hint $m_A = K_1 \cot(K_2 \theta)$ with $K_1 = 1$ and $K_2 = 2$.

$$W = \int_{T_0}^T C_c \left( \frac{T_h}{T_c} - 1 \right) dT_c = C_c \int_T^{T_0} \left( \frac{T_h}{T_c} - 1 \right) dT_c$$
$$W = C_c \left[ T_h \ln(T_c) - T_c \right]_T^{T_0} = C_c \left( T_h \ln\frac{T_0}{T} - T_0 + T \right)$$

**3. Overall Coefficient of Performance, COP:**
The coefficient of performance is defined as the ratio of the total heat extracted to the total work done:
$$COP = \frac{Q_c}{W} = \frac{C_c (T_0 - T)}{C_c \left( T_h \ln\frac{T_0}{T} - T_0 + T \right)}$$

The $C_c$ terms cancel out, leaving the COP purely in terms of the temperatures:
$$COP = \frac{T_0 - T}{T_h \ln\frac{T_0}{T} - T_0 + T}$$
